017package org.apache.juneau.console;
018
019import java.util.*;
020import java.util.regex.*;
021
022/**
023 * The model block of one element: handler actions, lifecycle bindings and handler subscriptions.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * Builders that implement {@link Handled} own one of these.  Every mutator validates at once and throws
027 * {@link IllegalArgumentException} naming the element.  These checks duplicate the client rules, which are the authority.
028 *
029 * @since 10.0.0
030 */
031public final class ModelBlock {
032
033   private static final Pattern TEMPLATE = Pattern.compile("\\{(rowKey|tabId|cardId)}");
034   private static final Pattern ANY_BRACE = Pattern.compile("[{}]");
035
036   private static final Map<String,Set<String>> EVENTS = Map.of(
037      "page", Set.of("loaded"),
038      "card", Set.of("loaded", "rendered"),
039      "table", Set.of("loaded", "rendered"),
040      "row", Set.of("rendered", "expanded", "collapsed"),
041      "rowdetail", Set.of("loaded", "rendered"),
042      "detailtab", Set.of("loaded", "rendered", "activated"),
043      "ribbonitem", Set.of("activated"),
044      "pagetab", Set.of("activated"),
045      "view", Set.of("activated"),
046      "chart", Set.of("loaded", "rendered"));
047
048   private static final Map<String,Set<String>> TEMPLATE_SCOPE = Map.of(
049      "rowKey", Set.of("row", "rowdetail", "detailtab"),
050      "tabId", Set.of("detailtab"));
051
052   private final String kind;
053   private final String elementId;
054   private final Map<String,ModelAction> actions = new LinkedHashMap<>();
055   private final Map<String,HandlerRef> on = new LinkedHashMap<>();
056   private final List<Map.Entry<String,HandlerRef>> subscribes = new ArrayList<>();
057
058   /**
059    * Creates a block.
060    *
061    * @param kind The element kind: page, card, table, row, rowdetail, detailtab, ribbonitem, pagetab, view or chart.
062    * @param elementId The element id, used in messages.
063    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the kind is unknown.
064    */
065   public ModelBlock(String kind, String elementId) {
066      if (! EVENTS.containsKey(kind))
067         throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown element kind '" + kind + "': " + new TreeSet<>(EVENTS.keySet()));
068      this.kind = kind;
069      this.elementId = elementId;
070   }
071
072   private IllegalArgumentException err(String msg) {
073      return new IllegalArgumentException(kind + " '" + elementId + "': " + msg);
074   }
075
076   /**
077    * Adds an action.
078    *
079    * @param a The action; must have a handler.
080    * @return This object.
081    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the kind takes no actions, the id repeats, or no handler is set.
082    */
083   public ModelBlock action(ModelAction a) {
084      if ("page".equals(kind))
085         throw err("a page takes no actions.");
086      if (a.handlerRef() == null)
087         throw err("action '" + a.id() + "' has no handler.");
088      if (actions.containsKey(a.id()))
089         throw err("duplicate action id '" + a.id() + "'.");
090      actions.put(a.id(), a);
091      return this;
092   }
093
094   /**
095    * Binds a lifecycle event.
096    *
097    * @param event A documented event of this kind.
098    * @param handler The handler.
099    * @return This object.
100    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the event is not documented for this kind.
101    */
102   public ModelBlock on(String event, HandlerRef handler) {
103      if (! EVENTS.get(kind).contains(event))
104         throw err("event '" + event + "' is not one of " + new TreeSet<>(EVENTS.get(kind)) + ".");
105      on.put(event, Objects.requireNonNull(handler, "handler"));
106      return this;
107   }
108
109   /**
110    * Subscribes a handler to a bus topic.
111    *
112    * @param topic A topic; the key may hold {@code {rowKey}}, {@code {tabId}} or {@code {cardId}} where this kind provides them.
113    * @param handler The handler.
114    * @return This object.
115    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the topic is invalid or a template is not available here.
116    */
117   public ModelBlock subscribe(String topic, HandlerRef handler) {
118      if ("page".equals(kind))
119         throw err("a page takes no subscriptions.");
120      if (topic == null)
121         throw err("topic must not be null.");
122      var m = TEMPLATE.matcher(topic);
123      while (m.find()) {
124         var scope = TEMPLATE_SCOPE.get(m.group(1));
125         if (scope != null && ! scope.contains(kind))
126            throw err("template {" + m.group(1) + "} is not available here.");
127      }
128      try {
129         var concrete = TEMPLATE.matcher(topic).replaceAll("k");
130         if (ANY_BRACE.matcher(concrete).find())
131            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid topic '" + topic + "'");
132         Topics.checkTopic(concrete);
133      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
134         throw err(e.getMessage());
135      }
136      subscribes.add(Map.entry(topic, Objects.requireNonNull(handler, "handler")));
137      return this;
138   }
139
140   /**
141    * Re-checks the whole block.
142    *
143    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If any entry is invalid.
144    */
145   public void validate() {
146      on.keySet().forEach(e -> {
147         if (! EVENTS.get(kind).contains(e))
148            throw err("event '" + e + "' is not one of " + new TreeSet<>(EVENTS.get(kind)) + ".");
149      });
150      actions.values().forEach(a -> {
151         if (a.handlerRef() == null)
152            throw err("action '" + a.id() + "' has no handler.");
153      });
154   }
155
156   /**
157    * Appends every entry of another block to this one.
158    *
159    * @param other The block to copy from.
160    * @return This object.
161    */
162   public ModelBlock addAll(ModelBlock other) {
163      other.actions.values().forEach(this::action);
164      other.on.forEach(this::on);
165      other.subscribes.forEach(e -> subscribe(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
166      return this;
167   }
168
169   /**
170    * Returns whether the block holds nothing.
171    *
172    * @return <jk>true</jk> if empty.
173    */
174   public boolean isEmpty() {
175      return actions.isEmpty() && on.isEmpty() && subscribes.isEmpty();
176   }
177
178   /**
179    * Returns whether any entry uses an inline handler.
180    *
181    * @return <jk>true</jk> if an inline reference is present.
182    */
183   public boolean hasInline() {
184      return on.values().stream().anyMatch(HandlerRef::isInline)
185         || subscribes.stream().anyMatch(e -> e.getValue().isInline())
186         || actions.values().stream().anyMatch(a -> a.handlerRef().isInline());
187   }
188
189   /**
190    * Returns the actions in insertion order.
191    *
192    * @return The actions, as contract maps.
193    */
194   public List<Map<String,Object>> actionMaps() {
195      return actions.values().stream().map(ModelAction::toMap).toList();
196   }
197
198   /**
199    * Returns the element id.
200    *
201    * @return The id.
202    */
203   public String elementId() {
204      return elementId;
205   }
206
207   /**
208    * Returns the element kind.
209    *
210    * @return The kind.
211    */
212   public String kind() {
213      return kind;
214   }
215
216   /**
217    * Serializes to the contract {@code model} object.
218    *
219    * @return The map, or <jk>null</jk> when empty so that builders not using the model emit unchanged JSON.
220    */
221   public Map<String,Object> toMap() {
222      if (isEmpty())
223         return null;
224      var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
225      if (! actions.isEmpty())
226         m.put("actions", actionMaps());
227      if (! on.isEmpty()) {
228         var o = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
229         on.forEach((k, v) -> o.put(k, v.toJson()));
230         m.put("on", o);
231      }
232      if (! subscribes.isEmpty()) {
233         var l = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
234         for (var e : subscribes) {
235            var s = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
236            s.put("topic", e.getKey());
237            s.put("handler", e.getValue().toJson());
238            l.add(s);
239         }
240         m.put("subscribes", l);
241      }
242      return m;
243   }
244}
